description: Bug Fixes Sprint - Fix core concepts display, citation navigation, graph performance/visualization, and EPUB support

userStories.title: Fix Core Concepts API return format
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see the correct list of core concepts so that I can quickly access important concepts from the book.
acceptanceCriteria: Fix getCoreConcepts API to return array format instead of object
Add Array.isArray defensive check in CoreConceptsList component
Backend SQL query correctly returns core concepts with is_core=true
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Backend fix first - ensure API returns GraphNode[]

userStories.title: Fix EPUB parser text extraction
userStories.description: As a developer, I need EPUB parser to correctly extract text content for concept extraction.
acceptanceCriteria: Fix epub_parser.rs HTML parsing logic to extract clean text
Extract chapter structure with position mapping
Rust compilation passes with no warnings
Unit test with sample EPUB file passes

userStories.title: Add chunk content API endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an API to retrieve chunk content and position for citation navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Add GET /api/chunks/{id} endpoint to main.rs
Return chunk content, page_number, and book_id
Handle 404 error for non-existent chunks
Rust compilation passes
Test endpoint returns correct chunk data
userStories.notes: Backend fix - needed for citation navigation

userStories.title: Fix EPUB reader component rendering
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view EPUB format books in the reader so that I can read EPUB files.
acceptanceCriteria: Fix EPUBReader component to render EPUB HTML content correctly
Add chapter navigation sidebar
Support text selection and highlighting
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Fix EPUB concept extraction integration
userStories.description: As a user, I want to extract concepts from EPUB books so that I can build concept graphs from EPUB sources.
acceptanceCriteria: Fix extractor to pass EPUB content to LLM correctly
Extracted concepts include chapter position info
Source citations link to correct EPUB locations
Rust compilation passes
Test EPUB upload and extraction flow

userStories.title: Add Source Citation click navigation
userStories.description: As a user, I want to click on source citations to jump to the exact location in the PDF/EPUB so that I can verify the context.
acceptanceCriteria: Modify NodeDetailPanel to show chunk preview instead of hex ID
Click citation calls onCitationClick callback with chunk ID
MainContent handles citation click and jumps to PDF/EPUB position
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: clicking citation jumps to correct location

userStories.title: Fix Related Concepts to show node names
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see related concept names instead of hex IDs so that I can understand the relationships.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetch related node details via getNode API in NodeDetailPanel
Display node names instead of hex IDs in Related Concepts section
Click Related Concept opens its details in the panel
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: Related Concepts show names and are clickable

userStories.title: Optimize Graph rendering performance
userStories.description: As a user, I want the concept graph to render smoothly even with many nodes so that I can interact without lag.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit initial node render to 50 most important nodes
Add 'Load More' button to render additional nodes
Optimize d3AlphaDecay to 0.05 and d3VelocityDecay to 0.4
Hide labels when zoom < 0.3 for performance
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: 100+ nodes graph is smooth

userStories.title: Add Graph node category color coding
userStories.description: As a user, I want related concepts to be grouped visually so that I can understand the structure of knowledge.
acceptanceCriteria: Assign colors to nodes based on category field
Add legend showing color-category mapping
Core concepts have distinct visual treatment (purple)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: nodes have category colors

userStories.title: Add Graph node filter controls
userStories.description: As a user, I want to filter the graph to show only core concepts or specific categories so that I can focus on what's important.
acceptanceCriteria: Add filter toolbar: Show Core Only / Show All toggle
Add category filter dropdown
Add node name search input
Filters update graph in real-time
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: filters work correctly

userStories.title: Improve Graph node visual design
userStories.description: As a user, I want nodes to be visually distinct and easy to click so that I can navigate the graph intuitively.
acceptanceCriteria: Increase minimum node size to ensure 44px click area
Add hover effect: scale up and shadow
Show tooltip on hover with full name and description
Core concept nodes have crown icon or glow effect
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: nodes are easy to click and visually distinct

userStories.title: Align EPUB feature parity with PDF
userStories.description: As a user, I want EPUB and PDF to have the same feature set so that my experience is consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: EPUB supports 'View in Book' navigation from citations
EPUB reader UI matches PDF reader layout
EPUB supports concept highlighting in text
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: EPUB has feature parity with PDF
